description: This file defines a Java interface 'LoggerConfig' which provides methods for accessing and serializing configurations related to loggers in a system. It includes method signatures for retrieving logger level and name, and defines related JSON field constants.

classes.name: LoggerConfig
classes.description: An interface for accessing the configuration of loggers, providing methods to retrieve log level and logger name, and to serialize the configuration into JSON.

classes.name: LoggerConfig.JsonFields
classes.description: A final class containing JSON field definitions for LoggerConfig fields 'level' and 'logger'.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the LogLevel to set for the logger.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the logger name to change, if present.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the LoggerConfig object into a JsonObject including only non-hidden marked fields.
